compilerArgs: Additional compiler arguments separated by whitespace, as in CPH (for example -std=c++20 -O0). Compiler/toolchain selection, output ownership, static linking and BeCoder macros cannot be overridden.
timeOut: Time limit per test or custom checker in milliseconds.
hideCompileStderr: Hide compiler standard error when compilation succeeds.
ignoreSTDERROR: Do not treat program standard error as a runtime error. Keep enabled to use debug output; nonzero program exit codes still fail.
hideOutputDifference: Hide inline output differences. Disable to show missing and extra tokens for incorrect answers.
pythonCommand: External Python executable used only for custom checker scripts. Uses python on Windows when set to python3. C/C++ solutions always use BeCoder's bundled compiler.
defaultLanguage: Default language for imported problems. Select none to choose on each import.
templateFile: Template file for new source files. Absolute paths and paths relative to the selected workspace folder are supported. Existing source files are never overwritten.
templateVariables: Replace $var$ in the template with the problem value, for example $url$, $name$, $date$ and $time$.
includeProblemIndex: Include the problem index in generated filenames.
wordRegex: Regular expression defining words in generated filenames. Words are separated by underscores.
shortCodeforces: Use short Codeforces filenames, such as 123A.cpp.
shortLuogu: Use short Luogu filenames, such as P1001.cpp.
shortAtCoder: Use short AtCoder filenames, such as abc311a.cpp.
retainWebviewContext: Keep the judge view context when hidden. Uses additional memory; reload the window to apply.
autoShowJudge: Automatically show the judge view when opening a file with an associated problem or importing a problem.
description: Integrated competitive programming sample tests using BeCoder's compiler.
